title: Variables are named and given a role
The direction of the effect is stated
The comparison is stated (compared to what?)
The form of the relationship is stated
The smallest effect size of interest (or expected bounds) is stated
The result that would count against the hypothesis is stated
Population and boundary conditions are stated
There is a plan to show each manipulation worked
The derivation from theory is explicit
The theory that could be shown wrong is named
The test is set up to be able to fail
Confirmatory vs exploratory status and priority are clear
Predictions and criteria are worded definitely
